select:
/* HcpApiMyPageMapper.getMyAllApi 나의 구독 및 권한 요청 목록 조회
목록 집계 기준 1. 구독 상태: SVC_ID + KEY_ID + SUB_STAT_CD 2. 권한 상태: SVC_ID + KEY_ID + REQ_STAT_CD */
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( /* * 사용자가 접근할 수 있는 Key * * HCP_API_KEY_AUTH에 같은 Key가 여러 건 존재하면 * 최종 목록이 중복될 수 있으므로 Key별 한 행으로 만든다. */ SELECT HAK.KEY_ID, MAX(HAK.KEY_NAME) AS KEY_NAME, MAX(HAKA.AUTH_CD) AS AUTH_CD, MAX(HAKA.PRJ_ID) AS PRJ_ID, MAX(HAKA.AUTH_ID) AS AUTH_ID
FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK
JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAKA.KEY_ID = HAK.KEY_ID
JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{empNo})) PRJ ON PRJ.PRJ_ID = HAKA.PRJ_ID
WHERE NOT ( HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAK.OWNER_ID != #{empNo} )
AND HAK.KEY_ID IN
#{item}
GROUP BY HAK.KEY_ID ),
RUNNING_SERVICE AS ( /* * 현재 환경에서 조회 가능한 서비스 */ SELECT S.SVC_ID, S.SVC_NM, S.SVC_TYPE, S.SVC_MODEL, S.SVC_DESC, S.SHOW_YN, S.DEL_YN, S.RES_DTTM
FROM HCP_API_SVC S
WHERE S.SVC_ENV = '${hcp.application.env}' AND S.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND ( S.DEL_YN = 'N' OR ( S.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND S.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE ) )
AND S.SVC_TYPE = UPPER(#{svcType})
AND LOWER(S.SVC_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{search}) || '%'
),
STATUS_INFO AS ( /* * 권한 요청 상태 * * 동일한 서비스 + Key + 상태는 한 행으로 표시한다. * REG_USER_ID는 최신 UPD_DTTM의 사용자와 맞춰 가져온다. */ SELECT R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID,
'NONE' AS SUB_STAT_CD, 'AUTH_' || R.REQ_STAT_CD AS REQ_STAT_CD,
MAX(R.REG_USER_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY R.UPD_DTTM, R.REG_USER_ID ) AS REG_USER_ID,
MAX(R.UPD_DTTM) AS UPD_DTTM
FROM HCP_API_SVC_REQ R
WHERE R.REQ_STAT_CD != 'NOR'
GROUP BY R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD
UNION ALL
/* * 구독 상태 * * 동일한 서비스 + Key + 상태는 한 행으로 표시한다. */ SELECT B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID,
'SUB_' || SUB.SUB_STAT_CD AS SUB_STAT_CD, 'NONE' AS REQ_STAT_CD,
MAX(SUB.REG_USER_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY SUB.UPD_DTTM, SUB.REG_USER_ID ) AS REG_USER_ID,
MAX(SUB.UPD_DTTM) AS UPD_DTTM
FROM HCP_API_SUB SUB
JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON P.PUB_ID = SUB.PUB_ID
JOIN HCP_API_BASE B ON B.API_ID = P.API_ID
WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD != 'CCL'
GROUP BY B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD ),
SUB_COUNT_INFO AS ( /* * 서비스별 현재 구독 중인 Key 개수 */ SELECT B.SVC_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUB.KEY_ID) AS SUB_COUNT
FROM HCP_API_SUB SUB
JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON P.PUB_ID = SUB.PUB_ID
JOIN HCP_API_BASE B ON B.API_ID = P.API_ID
WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD = 'NOR'
GROUP BY B.SVC_ID ),
REG_USER_INFO AS ( SELECT FU.EMP_NO, FU.NAME_KOR, FU.EMAIL, FU.STATUS_CD, FD.NAME_KOR AS DEPT_KOR, FP.NAME_KOR AS POS_KOR
FROM FR_USER FU
JOIN FR_DEPT FD ON FD.DEPT_ID = FU.DEPT_ID
LEFT JOIN FR_POSITION FP ON FP.PSTN_ID = FU.PSTN_ID )
SELECT S.SVC_ID, S.SVC_NM, S.SVC_TYPE, S.SVC_MODEL, S.SVC_DESC,
ST.UPD_DTTM, ST.REG_USER_ID,
ST.SUB_STAT_CD, ST.REQ_STAT_CD,
CASE WHEN ST.SUB_STAT_CD != 'NONE' THEN ST.SUB_STAT_CD WHEN ST.REQ_STAT_CD != 'NONE' THEN ST.REQ_STAT_CD ELSE 'NONE' END AS STAT_CD,
NVL(RUI.NAME_KOR, '-') AS NAME_KOR, RUI.EMAIL, RUI.DEPT_KOR, RUI.POS_KOR,
ST.REG_USER_ID AS EMP_NO,
NVL(SCI.SUB_COUNT, 0) AS SUB_COUNT,
MKI.KEY_ID, MKI.KEY_NAME, MKI.AUTH_CD, MKI.PRJ_ID, MKI.AUTH_ID
FROM STATUS_INFO ST
JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = ST.KEY_ID
JOIN RUNNING_SERVICE S ON S.SVC_ID = ST.SVC_ID
LEFT JOIN SUB_COUNT_INFO SCI ON SCI.SVC_ID = ST.SVC_ID
LEFT JOIN REG_USER_INFO RUI ON RUI.EMP_NO = ST.REG_USER_ID AND RUI.STATUS_CD = 'C'
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( ST.SUB_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{subStatus}) OR ST.REQ_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{subStatus}) )
ORDER BY
SUB_COUNT
S.SVC_NM
S.SVC_TYPE
MKI.KEY_NAME
ST.UPD_DTTM
ASC
DESC

/* HcpApiMyPageMapper.selectMySubCount 나의 구독 상태별 집계
집계 기준: SVC_ID + KEY_ID + SUB_STAT_CD */
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT HAK.KEY_ID
FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK
JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAKA.KEY_ID = HAK.KEY_ID
JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{empNo})) PRJ ON PRJ.PRJ_ID = HAKA.PRJ_ID
WHERE NOT ( HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAK.OWNER_ID != #{empNo} )
AND HAK.KEY_ID IN
#{item}
),
RUNNING_SERVICE AS ( SELECT S.SVC_ID, S.SVC_TYPE, S.SHOW_YN
FROM HCP_API_SVC S
WHERE S.SVC_ENV = '${hcp.application.env}' AND ( S.DEL_YN = 'N' OR ( S.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND S.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE ) )
AND S.SVC_TYPE = UPPER(#{svcType})
),
SUB_STATUS_INFO AS ( SELECT S.SVC_ID, S.SHOW_YN, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD
FROM RUNNING_SERVICE S
JOIN HCP_API_BASE B ON B.SVC_ID = S.SVC_ID
JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON P.API_ID = B.API_ID
JOIN HCP_API_SUB SUB ON SUB.PUB_ID = P.PUB_ID
JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = SUB.KEY_ID
WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD != 'CCL'
GROUP BY S.SVC_ID, S.SHOW_YN, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD )
SELECT /* * 공개/비공개 포함 구독 중 */ NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SUB_STAT_CD = 'NOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS SUB_CNT,
/* * 공개 서비스의 구독 승인 대기 * * getMyAllApi(subStatus = SUB_APR)의 행 수와 같은 기준 */ NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SUB_STAT_CD = 'APR' AND SHOW_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS APR_CNT,
/* * 공개 서비스 구독 중 */ NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SUB_STAT_CD = 'NOR' AND SHOW_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS SHOW_CNT,
/* * 비공개 서비스 구독 중 */ NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN SUB_STAT_CD = 'NOR' AND SHOW_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS HID_CNT,
/* * 현재 환경의 유효 서비스 전체 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM RUNNING_SERVICE ) AS ALL_CNT
FROM SUB_STATUS_INFO

/* HcpApiMyPageMapper.getMyReqCount 나의 권한 요청 상태별 건수
집계 기준: SVC_ID + KEY_ID + REQ_STAT_CD */
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT HAK.KEY_ID
FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK
JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAKA.KEY_ID = HAK.KEY_ID
JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{empNo})) PRJ ON PRJ.PRJ_ID = HAKA.PRJ_ID
WHERE NOT ( HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAK.OWNER_ID != #{empNo} )
AND HAK.KEY_ID IN
#{item}
),
REQUEST_STATUS_INFO AS ( SELECT R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD
FROM HCP_API_SVC_REQ R
JOIN HCP_API_SVC S ON S.SVC_ID = R.SVC_ID AND S.SVC_ENV = '${hcp.application.env}'
JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = R.KEY_ID
WHERE S.SHOW_YN = 'Y'
AND ( S.DEL_YN = 'N' OR ( S.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND S.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE ) )
AND S.SVC_TYPE = UPPER(#{svcType})
AND R.REQ_STAT_CD = UPPER(#{keyword})
AND LOWER(S.SVC_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{search}) || '%'
GROUP BY R.SVC_ID, R.KEY_ID, R.REQ_STAT_CD )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM REQUEST_STATUS_INFO
